title: Set notification previews to Never in System Settings

source.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0; ported by reference (our own instruction, setup and checks; no source text copied)
source.changes: Instruction written in our own words. Start state as in the source (System Settings quit, com.apple.ncprefs content_visibility set to 2), but setup first keeps the Mac's own value and teardown puts it back. The check reads the same key and wants exactly 1 (the source's grep for "1" also matched values such as 10). No param: the source shows only that Never is 1, so the other choices' values are not known well enough to pick from.

setup.why: Keep the Mac's own preview setting for teardown, quit System Settings, and start from When Unlocked (2).

instruction: In the notification settings, make notification previews show never.

checks.why: com.apple.ncprefs content_visibility, which the Show Previews menu of System Settings › Notifications writes, is 1 (Never). Setup left 2, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Quit System Settings and put the Mac's own value back.

oracle.why: Write Never (1), as the Show Previews menu does.
